description: Reads the open model as the Point to Patch Convertor does: whether the deck is plates or a grillage, its levels and groups, the point loads (nodal and beam concentrated) per load case that could be dispersed, any PATCH_ cases already written, and every preset with what it still needs. Read-only.

active.description: Limit to elements: { groups: [names], useZ, zMin, zMax }.
